text: This solution, Fourth Disaster Risk Management Development Policy Loan with a Catastrophe-Deferred Drawdown Option (CAT-DDO 4) addresses natural catastrophe in Republic of the Philippines between Government of the Philippines, International Bank for Reconstruction and Development (IBRD), World Bank, Japan–World Bank Program for Mainstreaming Disaster Risk Management in Developing Countries, and Global Facility for Disaster Reduction and Recovery (GFDRR). The program was implemented in 2021 and focuses on collaboration and regulation.
